text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "PED aims at supporting urban energy transitions through innovative solutions for the planning, large-scale implementation, and replication of PEDs with the mission to bring forward at least 100 PEDs by 2025", "gist": "PED's goal is to advance urban energy transitions by developing and replicating at least 100 PEDs by 2025"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "it will contribute to the Mission on Climate-Neutral and Smart Cities by building a portfolio of PED-related solutions towards climate-neutrality", "gist": "PED will support the Climate-Neutral and Smart Cities Mission by creating solutions for climate neutrality"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The 15-Minute City transition pathway focusses on rethinking the existing mobility system and urban morphology to encourage sustainable mobility choices, redistribute urban space and reorganise our daily activities so to make our cities more climate neutral, livable and inclusive", "gist": "The 15-Minute City pathway aims to redesign cities for sustainability, livability, and inclusivity by improving mobility and urban space"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "100", "gist": "Target number of PEDs to be brought forward by 2025"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "2025", "gist": "Deadline for achieving the PED target"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Mission on Climate-Neutral and Smart Cities", "gist": "A specific mission or initiative focused on climate-neutral and smart cities"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "PEDs", "gist": "Planned Energy Districts or similar urban energy transition projects"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "15-Minute City transition pathway", "gist": "A specific urban planning concept or initiative"}]}
